review_description: A responsive and cooperative company that used quality products for our installation. Other options were significantly cheaper but the quality of their products were questionable and they were unable/unwilling to divulge the subcontractors who would be undertaking the work. Most disconcerting was the high pressure tactics employed to gain the contract - something that I will not accept, no matter the cost or quality of their product. Our chosen company arranged the grid connection and provided training on using the system.
Quote process very efficient and well informed.Kept up to date with proceedings.Always very polite.Removed all packaging and left tidy.Helped with connection process.
Minefield dealing  with Power Distributors and Retailers but we got there.
The system would be very very good but for the poor performing grid in North West Victoria. That implies poor management by the foreign ownership, Powercor.

I had a few personal recommendations for Mildura Solar so I chose them over another local installer. The sales bloke was very informative and showed me their monitoring web portal and talked about my needs. Once the deposit was paid, the communication was a bit lacking. It took me a few phone calls to find out that my install date would be postponed by 6 weeks due to inverter shortages. I had to call them to get updates and information which I thought was a bit poor. Come installation date, they started installing the rails on one side of the roof instead of east and west like I had discussed initially. Luckily it was caught before they put the panels on, but it was due to a break down in internal communication. Post install it looks good on the roof, a nice tidy installation and fit off for the inverter.
Green B had a 25% off for a 5 kW system @ $25000 which I thought was outrageous. Made it a $18k system.
Never received quotes from any suppliers through your website. Ended up having to google service providers and inquire about quotes myself.

It reminds me of the insulation scheme if things go wrong it's the local people who have the job of fixing the job.Going local their reputation is on the line, customer satisfaction means continued business.
Mildura Solar we very good went out of their way to answer our questions and gave us all the information we needed to make our dicession and did not force us to take a system that did not suit us.
They were easy to deal with and theyexplain all the tech stuff pretty well.
